draft: From my apartment window, I observe a gray Mexico City under constant overcast skies. The air smells of chemicals and decay while the streets remain quiet with occasional armored vehicle patrols around Zócalo. Banners display an absent leader, posters show soldiers and drones symbolizing authoritarian rule. Food is rationed, green spaces are guarded, and infrastructure collapses regularly as resilience turns to despair in this unrecognizable landscape.
